b51d7bb3a7a1b9ed.job_title: Specialist / Consultant Otolaryngologist (ENT) - Government Healthcare Sector
b51d7bb3a7a1b9ed.description: We are seeking highly qualified and experienced Specialist and Consultant Otolaryngologists (ENT Specialists) to join prestigious government healthcare institutions in Saudi Arabia. The ideal candidates will have extensive expertise in diagnosing, treating, and managing disorders affecting the ear, nose, throat, head, and neck. Candidates should demonstrate strong clinical and surgical skills in managing a wide range of ENT conditions and performing specialized procedures. This is an excellent opportunity for experienced ENT professionals to advance their careers in a well-established healthcare environment equipped with advanced medical technologies and modern surgical facilities. We welcome applications from internationally qualified professionals, particularly those holding UK CCT, Western Qualified, American Board, Australian Board, or German Board qualifications. Key Responsibilities Diagnose and manage a wide range of ear, nose, and throat conditions. Perform ENT surgical procedures according to the candidate's area of expertise. Manage hearing disorders, sinus diseases, tonsil and adenoid conditions, and voice disorders. Perform procedures such as endoscopic sinus surgery, tonsillectomy, and other specialized ENT interventions. Evaluate and manage head and neck disorders. Conduct comprehensive patient assessments and develop individualized treatment plans. Provide pre-operative and post-operative patient care. Manage ENT emergencies and complex clinical cases. Collaborate with audiologists, speech therapists, radiologists, and other healthcare professionals. Maintain accurate medical records and clinical documentation. Ensure compliance with clinical protocols, patient safety standards, and medical ethics. Medical degree (MBBS, MD, or equivalent) from a recognized institution. Recognized postgraduate qualification in Otolaryngology / ENT. Minimum of 3–5 years of relevant post-specialization experience. Consultant applicants must demonstrate extensive clinical and surgical experience with recognized consultant-level qualifications. Specialist and Consultant applicants with internationally recognized qualifications such as UK CCT, Western Qualified, American Board, Australian Board, or German Board are highly preferred. Strong clinical expertise in ENT diagnosis, treatment, and surgical procedures. Experience in advanced ENT surgical techniques is an advantage. Excellent communication, clinical decision-making, and interpersonal skills. Ability to work effectively within a multidisciplinary healthcare environment. Commitment to delivering high-quality, patient-centered care. Competitive annual salary based on qualifications and experience. Attractive employment benefits. Opportunity to work within reputable government healthcare institutions in Saudi Arabia. Access to advanced medical facilities and surgical technologies. Professional and multicultural working environment. Opportunities for career advancement and professional development. Long-term career opportunities within the Saudi healthcare sector.

Report maintenance needs, accidents, injuries, and unsafe work conditions to management. Complete all required safety training and certifications. Capability to reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping. Ability to move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing up to 25 pounds without assistance. Qualifications and Experience Candidates should possess 0-1 year of relevant experience. The role requires the ability to perform various job duties as requested by Supervisors, maintaining flexibility and responsiveness in a dynamic kitchen environment.

b56bd37613c28781.job_title: AFCAP V PSAB BOSS: Journeyman Electrician (Secret Clearance)
b56bd37613c28781.description: About the Role KBR, Inc. is seeking a Journeyman Electrician for the AFCAP V Saudi Arabia- PSAB BOSS program. This full-time position is based in Riyadh and Al-Kharj, requiring 2-5 years of experience and a Secret Clearance. The role focuses on ensuring high-quality electrical installations, maintenance, repair, and installation of various electrical equipment and support systems on commercial/industrial projects, including government initiatives. Program Overview The KBR PSAB Program delivers comprehensive Base Operating Support-Installation (BOS-I) services at Prince Sultan Air Base (PSAB) in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia (KSA). These services support the 378 Air Expeditionary Wing (AEW), mission partners, and tenant units, including transient, temporary duty (TDY), permanent party, and rotational personnel. The program also extends its services to five remote Army sites within PSAB, ensuring seamless operations, maintenance, and support essential for sustained mission readiness and operational effectiveness. Key Responsibilities Report to and receive assignments, instructions, and direction from the Master Electrician or Supervisor. Oversee Preventative Maintenance Schedules and coordinate with department leadership to supervise electrical crews performing inspections and repairs on equipment. This includes instrumentation, inverter drives, DCS/SCADA, LV and HV motors, switchgear and control gear, Automatic Transfer Switches (ATS), AC and DC systems, variable speed drives, and specialized control panels. Ensure the highest quality standards are met or exceeded in all installations. Maintain, repair, replace, or install a broad range of electrical equipment and systems for base construction and maintenance activities. Observe and follow all safety rules and procedures, including wearing required personal protective equipment. Identify and repair deficiencies found during PMI / TI inspections. Complete records, maintain tools and equipment, and perform various clean-up and housekeeping activities. Identify proper materials for specific installations, submit material requisitions through the procurement process, and follow up with materials and/or logistics personnel until received. Engage in continuing professional development in electrical technologies. Perform other duties as assigned. Qualifications and Requirements Minimum of 2-5 years of experience as an Electrician. Ability to perform maintenance, repair, and installation of electrical equipment and systems. Proficiency in identifying and resolving electrical deficiencies. Demonstrated adherence to safety protocols and use of personal protective equipment. Experience with procurement processes for electrical materials. Must possess a Secret Clearance. KBR Benefits KBR offers a selection of competitive lifestyle benefits, which may include a 401K plan with company match, medical, dental, vision, life insurance, AD&D, flexible spending account, disability, paid time off, or a flexible work schedule. KBR supports career advancement through professional training and development and is an equal opportunity employer.

b5a67fc342a28454.description: About AtkinsRéalis AtkinsRéalis is a global engineering services and nuclear organization dedicated to transforming infrastructure and energy systems. The company connects people, data, and technology to engineer a better future for the planet and its people, collaborating with industry partners, clients, and a global team of consultants, designers, engineers, and project managers. The Opportunity: Planning & Reporting Manager AtkinsRéalis is seeking a Planning & Reporting Manager to lead project planning, scheduling, controls, and performance reporting for a major infrastructure and landscape project in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role is critical for developing integrated schedules, monitoring project performance, managing reporting systems, and providing accurate project insights to support informed decision-making and successful project delivery. Key Responsibilities Lead the development and maintenance of integrated project schedules, encompassing design, procurement, construction, commissioning, and handover activities. Manage project reporting processes, ensuring timely delivery of accurate progress reports, dashboards, KPIs, and management presentations. Monitor project performance against schedule baselines, identifying trends, risks, and recovery opportunities. Coordinate with project teams, consultants, and contractors to gather, validate, and analyze project data. Develop forecasting models and provide schedule impact assessments to support project decision-making. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Project Management, or a related discipline. Minimum of 15 years of experience in planning, project controls, and reporting on major infrastructure and landscape projects. Extensive experience with Primavera P6, project controls systems, reporting tools, and dashboard solutions. Strong understanding of scheduling methodologies, earned value management, cost and schedule performance analysis, and risk management. Experience delivering large-scale projects within the Middle East, preferably in Saudi Arabia. Professional certifications such as PMP, PSP (Planning & Scheduling Professional), or equivalent are highly desirable. Required Skills Excellent analytical and presentation skills. Strong communication and stakeholder management abilities. Ability to manage large datasets, project metrics, and reporting requirements across complex projects. Rewards and Benefits AtkinsRéalis offers a comprehensive rewards and benefits package designed to support employees at every stage of their life and career. This includes a tax-free salary, life insurance coverage, medical insurance, annual leave balance, a company gratuity scheme, a discretionary bonus program, an annual flight contribution, and transportation & housing allowances. Employees also benefit from a Wellbeing Program providing 24/7 access to specialists in finance, legal matters, family care, personal health, fitness, and nutrition.

b54d00594a90980f.description: About Cyber At Cyber, we focus on strengthening organizational resilience through robust cybersecurity governance, risk management, and regulatory compliance. We operate in alignment with the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia’s regulatory landscape, ensuring adherence to NCA, SAMA, and international best practices. The Role of Cybersecurity GRC Specialist We are seeking a Cybersecurity GRC Specialist to support and enhance our Governance, Risk, Compliance, and Security Awareness programs. This full-time role is based in Jeddah, Makkah, and requires 2-5 years of experience. Key Responsibilities Develop, implement, and maintain cybersecurity governance policies, frameworks, and standards. Monitor organizational adherence to established cybersecurity policies and controls. Provide periodic governance and risk posture reports to the CISO and executive leadership. Maintain cybersecurity documentation aligned with regulatory and industry standards. Conduct comprehensive cybersecurity risk assessments across business units and cloud environments. Drive remediation efforts and ensure timely closure of identified risks and audit findings. Ensure compliance with KSA regulatory frameworks (*, NCA ECC, SAMA CSF) and international standards such as ISO 27001. Support internal and external audit activities. Support and promote cybersecurity awareness initiatives across the organization. Assist in managing awareness tools and programs. Foster a strong cybersecurity culture and ensure employee understanding of risks and responsibilities. Experience Required 2-5 years of experience in a relevant cybersecurity role.

b50e5d2fed3e19e2.description: About DataVolt DataVolt is a global leader specializing in sustainable and innovative data center solutions. b521c109d86fd9bb.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة خيال الخليج عن أخصائي مبيعات للانضمام إلى فريقها في مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور على تعزيز المبيعات داخل المعرض، وتوسيع قاعدة العملاء، بالإضافة إلى إدارة الحضور الرقمي للشركة عبر منصات التواصل الاجتماعي. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة، وهو متاح بدوام كامل. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية استقبال العملاء في المعرض وتحديد احتياجاتهم لتقديم المنتجات والحلول المناسبة. شرح مواصفات ومميزات المنتجات، بما في ذلك كاميرات المراقبة وأنظمة التسجيل والشبكات. إعداد عروض الأسعار ومتابعة العملاء لإتمام عمليات البيع. استقطاب عملاء جدد وبناء علاقات تجارية مستدامة. إدارة حسابات الشركة على منصات التواصل الاجتماعي. إعداد وتصميم ونشر المحتوى التسويقي والتعريفي بالمنتجات والعروض. تصوير المنتجات وإنتاج وتحرير الفيديوهات التسويقية والمقاطع القصيرة. متابعة استفسارات وتفاعلات العملاء عبر منصات التواصل الاجتماعي. المساهمة في تنفيذ الحملات الإعلانية لتحسين الحضور الرقمي للشركة وزيادة المبيعات. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال المبيعات أو التسويق. القدرة على التواصل الفعال مع العملاء واستقطاب عملاء جدد. فهم جيد لمنتجات كاميرات المراقبة وأنظمة التسجيل والشبكات. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات ممتازة في التواصل والعرض. القدرة على إدارة حسابات التواصل الاجتماعي وإنشاء المحتوى. مهارات في التصوير وإنتاج وتحرير الفيديو. القدرة على العمل بشكل مستقل وكجزء من فريق. بيئة العمل يعمل أخصائي المبيعات بدوام كامل في مكة المكرمة، ضمن بيئة عمل ديناميكية تركز على تحقيق الأهداف البيعية وتعزيز التواجد الرقمي للشركة. معلومات إضافية الراتب الخاص بهذا الدور سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة.

b52a7b45971d549b.description: About KBox Global and the GFVx Network KBox Global, operating as Global Food Ventures (GFV), is expanding its network of virtual food brands globally. The company partners with restaurants and underutilised kitchens to launch delivery-first food brands, enabling partners to generate additional revenue from existing kitchen capacity. GFV brands currently operate across the Middle East and Europe, with a focus on expanding the restaurant partner network in Saudi Arabia. To support this expansion, GFV has launched GFVx, a global partner network designed to connect experienced hospitality professionals with restaurant operators seeking revenue growth. This is a contract-based, performance-based partner opportunity located in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, requiring 0-1 years of experience. The Restaurant Growth Partner Opportunity As a GFVx Restaurant Growth Partner, you will introduce restaurants to GFV’s virtual brand system, facilitating the launch of delivery-focused brands using their existing kitchen infrastructure. This role is suitable for professionals within the KSA hospitality and restaurant ecosystem who possess strong industry relationships. Partners earn commissions and recurring revenue from each restaurant introduced to the platform. Key Responsibilities Identify restaurants with unused kitchen capacity. Introduce restaurant owners and operators to GFV’s virtual brand model. Support restaurants through the onboarding process. Assist restaurants in successfully launching GFV delivery brands. Build and manage a portfolio of restaurant partners. Maintain relationships with partner restaurants. Contribute to the expansion of GFV’s kitchen network across the KSA market. Ideal Candidate Profile This opportunity is suited for professionals already active within the KSA food and hospitality industry. Candidates should possess strong relationships with restaurant owners or operators and understand restaurant operations and economics. Industry access and relationships are considered more valuable than formal sales experience. Required Qualifications and Skills Experience in the hospitality or restaurant sector. Strong existing relationships with restaurant owners or operators. Comfort with commercial conversations. Understanding of restaurant operations and economics. Proactive and self-motivated approach. Benefits of Partnership Opportunity to build an independent revenue stream through commissions and ongoing revenue share. Engagement with a company expanding across multiple international markets. Flexible work model allowing independent operation and portfolio growth. Leverage existing hospitality connections into sustainable income. Participation in the growing virtual brands and delivery-first kitchen market.

b5d0d04410333ec2.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة Makarem Al Nokhba عن أخصائي ضمان الجودة والتميز التشغيلي للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى ضمان تطبيق معايير الجودة الدولية وتحسين العمليات التشغيلية داخل الشركة. المسؤوليات الرئيسية متابعة تطبيق معايير وأنظمة الجودة الدولية (ISO Standards). دعم وتطوير مبادرات التميز التشغيلي وتحسين العمليات. تنفيذ ومتابعة عمليات التدقيق الداخلي. إدارة ومراقبة الوثائق والإجراءات، وضمان تحديثها واعتمادها وفقاً للآليات المعتمدة. متابعة وتحليل مؤشرات الأداء الرئيسية (KPIs) وإعداد تقارير الأداء. تحديد فجوات العمليات وحالات عدم المطابقة، وتحليل الأسباب الجذرية ومتابعة الإجراءات التصحيحية والوقائية. مراجعة وتطوير السياسات والإجراءات وأدلة العمل. متابعة الالتزام بمتطلبات الجودة والتحسين المستمر. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 5 إلى 10 سنوات في مجال ضمان الجودة والتميز التشغيلي. فهم عميق لمعايير وأنظمة الجودة الدولية (ISO Standards). القدرة على تحليل البيانات وإعداد التقارير الفنية. بيئة العمل تتوفر هذه الفرصة في مدينة جدة، وهي وظيفة بدوام كامل ضمن فريق يسعى لتحقيق أعلى مستويات الجودة والتميز التشغيلي. التقديم لم يتم الكشف عن تفاصيل الراتب لهذه الوظيفة. يمكن للمرشحين المهتمين والذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه تقديم طلباتهم.

b59a3c9ee377d49e.description: About the Role Qiddiya Investment Company is seeking a Senior Manager - Cost Planning to join their team in Riyadh, Riyadh Province. This full-time role involves supporting the delivery of Qiddiya’s cost planning requirements within assigned business units, development projects, and governance activities. The Senior Manager will provide structured cost planning support, coordinate consultants, offer input for Stage Gate reviews, conduct benchmarking analysis, and assist with cost governance to ensure project budgets, cost plans, and design-to-budget decisions are evidence-based, consistent, and aligned with Qiddiya’s standards. Role Purpose and Context The primary purpose of this role is to support General Business Unit Cost Planning in applying consistent cost planning standards across Qiddiya’s business units and development assets. The Senior Manager will operate within the Business Unit cost planning environment, supporting the application of Qiddiya Cost Planning Technical Guidelines, asset class guidelines, cost planning processes, benchmarking requirements, and digital tools. While external cost consultants or project teams may prepare detailed cost plans, this role is responsible for reviewing assigned outputs, coordinating comments, maintaining cost planning records, and escalating key issues to leadership for review and decision-making. Key Accountabilities Coordinate cost planning activities for assigned projects, workstreams, business unit support activities, and development programmes. Support the implementation of Qiddiya Cost Planning Technical Guidelines, asset class guidelines, templates, trackers, reporting standards, and cost planning governance processes. Review and comment on cost consultant outputs, including cost plans, reconciliations, assumptions, risk allowances, benchmarks, cost reports, and design-to-budget recommendations. Maintain clear and current cost planning records for assigned projects, workstreams, or business unit support areas. Support Stage Gate reviews by checking cost planning readiness, completeness, compliance, and alignment with required deliverables. Coordinate with business units, development teams, design teams, commercial, procurement, finance, project controls, digital teams, and external consultants to support integrated cost planning outcomes. Support early-stage cost advice, feasibility input, benchmark checks, and pre-concept cost planning where required before the appointment of project cost consultants. Assist with the briefing, mobilisation, coordination, and performance monitoring of executive and project cost consultants. Track scope and cost movements across project phases and escalate material changes, risks, opportunities, and non-compliance issues in a timely and structured manner. Apply benchmarking data, cost planning software, digital tools, and cost planning analytics to support the review and validation of cost positions. Support business unit cost planning capability through training, onboarding, guidance, and adoption of Qiddiya ways of working. Contribute to the preparation of cost planning review packs, governance papers, leadership updates, dashboards, and trackers. Promote consistent ways of working, professional standards, and continuous improvement across the cost planning community. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 12 years of relevant experience in cost planning or a related field. Demonstrated ability to interpret cost, design, benchmark, and risk information. Experience in coordinating consultant deliverables and reviewing outputs. Proficiency in applying benchmarking data, cost planning software, and digital tools. Required Attributes Reliable and delivery-focused, with strong ownership of assigned tasks. Professional and constructive in reviewing information, raising issues, and supporting cost planning discussions. Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret complex data. Clear communicator capable of preparing structured comments, summaries, trackers, and updates. Collaborative and responsive when working with internal stakeholders and external consultants. Adaptable, proactive, and comfortable working in a fast-moving development environment. Committed to continuous improvement, knowledge sharing, and strengthening cost planning capabilities. Accountability in Relation to Cost Consultants While external cost consultants may prepare detailed cost plans, estimates, benchmarking outputs, risk allowances, cost reports, and supporting analysis, Qiddiya retains accountability for the recommended cost planning position. The Senior Manager supports this accountability by coordinating consultant deliverables, reviewing assigned outputs, recording comments and actions, and escalating key cost planning issues to business unit and cost planning leadership for review. This role ensures that consultant outputs align with Qiddiya Cost Planning Technical Guidelines, reflect approved briefs and design status, include appropriate assumptions and reconciliations, identify risks and opportunities, and provide reliable support for project and governance decisions.

b5887c66eb9dda68.description: About Salla and Mahally Salla is seeking an SEO Manager for Mahally, a marketplace connecting thousands of Saudi stores across various categories. The successful candidate will lead efforts to strengthen technical SEO, enhance indexation and discoverability, build scalable organic landing-page strategies, and achieve sustainable organic growth independent of individual merchants or products. Conduct structured tests on page templates and title/meta patterns, providing causal insights where possible. b5a215ae92ef9b2d.description: نبذة عن الوظيفة تبحث مجموعة المجال العربي عن فني أجهزة رقمية للانضمام إلى فريقها في الهفوف، المنطقة الشرقية. تتضمن هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل مسؤولية دراسة مخططات تركيب الأجهزة الرقمية، وإجراء التشغيل التجريبي، وإعداد قوائم قطع الغيار، بالإضافة إلى أداء مهام الصيانة الوقائية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة مخططات تركيب الأجهزة الرقمية، مثل آلات الألعاب والأزمات الرقمية، ومتابعة إجراءات تركيبها. القيام بإجراء التشغيل التجريبي للأجهزة الرقمية ومتابعة تشغيلها وفقاً لأدلة التشغيل. إعداد قائمة بقطع الغيار الاحتياطية اللازمة للأجهزة الرقمية والعمل على تأمينها. أداء عمليات الصيانة الوقائية، وتشخيص التلفيات والأعطال المحتملة، واتخاذ الإجراءات التصحيحية. تطبيق إجراءات وتعليمات السلامة والصحة المهنية. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين إلى 5 سنوات في مجال ذي صلة بالأجهزة الرقمية أو الصيانة الفنية. القدرة على فهم وتطبيق المخططات الفنية والتشغيلية للأجهزة الرقمية. معرفة جيدة بإجراءات السلامة والصحة المهنية. بيئة العمل تتوفر هذه الفرصة في الهفوف، المنطقة الشرقية، ضمن بيئة عمل احترافية في مجموعة المجال العربي. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب الالتزام بالمهام المحددة لضمان سير العمل بكفاءة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة. نشجع المرشحين المؤهلين على التقديم لهذه الفرصة في مجال صيانة وتشغيل الأجهزة الرقمية.

b5eaf32b9c3485f2.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة مجمع الرحمه الطبي عن مساعد خدمة اجتماعية للانضمام إلى فريقها في مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على إدارة وتنفيذ برامج المساعدات الاجتماعية والخدمة المجتمعية، بالإضافة إلى مساعدة العملاء في التعامل مع المسائل الشخصية والاجتماعية. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد الأبحاث والدراسات الاجتماعية لتحديد الاحتياجات المطلوبة في مجال الاختصاص، وتقديم التوصيات بناءً عليها. مساعدة الأشخاص ذوي الإعاقة أو كبار السن في الحصول على الخدمات الضرورية، والعمل على تحسين قدرتهم على العمل والاندماج في المجتمع. مساعدة العملاء في تحديد الخيارات المتاحة ووضع خطط عمل فعالة، وتقديم التوجيه بخصوص الموارد المجتمعية المتاحة، بما في ذلك المساعدات القانونية والطبية والمالية. المشاركة في عملية اختيار العملاء وقبولهم في البرامج الاجتماعية المناسبة لاحتياجاتهم. عقد ورش العمل للتدريب على مهارات الحياة، وبرامج إدارة السلوك، وغيرها من البرامج المجتمعية وبرامج الخدمة الاجتماعية، والعمل تحت إشراف المهنيين المتخصصين في هذا المجال. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال الخدمة الاجتماعية أو مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على إدارة برامج المساعدات الاجتماعية وتنفيذها بفعالية. مهارات قوية في التواصل لمساعدة العملاء في التعامل مع المسائل الشخصية والاجتماعية. بيئة العمل يعمل مساعد الخدمة الاجتماعية بدوام كامل ضمن فريق شركة مجمع الرحمه الطبي في مكة المكرمة. يتطلب الدور التفاعل المباشر مع العملاء والمجتمع المحلي لتقديم الدعم اللازم. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة خلال عملية التوظيف. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذا الدور في شركة مجمع الرحمه الطبي.

b555320ce7cb46c9.description: About Tabby Tabby is a FinTech company focused on reshaping financial interactions for consumers.
